audit.whatIsWrong: The page never said that Seismic Shard is a projectile Wind Wall blocks — the single cheapest thing Yasuo does in this lane.
audit.why: Seismic Shard (Q) carries the projectile flag, 625 range, flat 8s cooldown. Wind Wall deletes it. Meanwhile Unstoppable Force is correctly described as unstoppable by the wall: Riot's text is 'launches himself to a location at high speed', which is a dash, so the projectile flag on his R is a tooltip-parse artefact. The mirror reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall eats Seismic Shard (Q) every 8s; Unstoppable Force is a dash and no wall stops it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Malphite, and levels 4-5 and first item to Yasuo.
audit.why: The mirror's chart is Yasuo / Skill / Yasuo / Malphite / Malphite / Malphite / Yasuo. Level 1 he has one 8s shard and nothing in melee; from 4-5 on Ground Slam's attack-speed cut and his armour stacking turn extended trades against you well before crit pays off.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4-5 and first item flipped — matched full/content pairs, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike line said 'when Unstoppable Force is down' with no number, and spikes[0] referenced 'Thunderlord poke'.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — the largest punish window in the lane, and worth stating. Thunderlord's Decree is a long-removed rune; the actual early damage source is Seismic Shard plus the Thunderclap attack pattern.
audit.corrected: 130s written into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; spikes[0].text rebuilt around the real projectile interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explained why brawling him gets worse as he builds.
audit.why: Ground Slam deals magic damage based on HIS Armor, and Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his maximum health — so every defensive item he buys also raises his damage or his effective burst absorption. Thunderclap (W) additionally applies on-hit and resets his attack.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Land Unstoppable Force' — FALSE POSITIVE, that is his real R, and the claim attached to it (that it ignores Wind Wall) is correct. Two derived flags in malphite.json are misfires I deliberately did NOT write from: his R is flagged 'projectile' when Riot's text describes a self-launch (a dash), and both Q and E are flagged 'grounding' when the descriptions say only move-speed steal and attack-speed reduction. Per the brief's rule I trusted the descriptions. If the grounding flag were real it would be the most important fact in the matchup for a dash champion, so it is worth a human checking the parser.
